reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-22: MSTR's stop already fired 8/20 (crypto-proxy squeeze confirmed the fade thesis was fighting the tape, exactly as the entry note warned), leaving ~27% of the book in cash. This week's price-action scan found no fresh short candidate: semis (SMH) show topping signals but NVDA -- the sector bellwether -- is only 8% off its high heading into 8/26 earnings, so a short now is a binary-event bet, not a confirmed reversal, and is exactly the whipsaw pattern that has repeatedly stopped this book out; gold miners (GDX) and crypto are both in confirmed uptrends, not blow-off tops, so neither qualifies as a fade. On the long side, biotech (XBI) is a clean, confirmed breakout -- near 52-wk highs, sector described as breaking a multiyear bear market on M&A and AI-drug-discovery tailwinds -- exactly the trend-following long the mandate is built to ride, so deploying part of the idle cash into it. No other holding showed a trend break this week (JPM, ELV, UNP, V, PG, IJR, CVX all checked, all intact), so those stay at weight.
